role: Chief Medical Officer agent; source/copy evidence review, not human clinician approval
scope: Read-only clinical review of the implemented independent hs-CRP3.2 teaching example; rendered visual/browser review belongs to the UX and independent judge agents.

checks.independent_example: Approved: value3.2mg/L, scale0–6, separate teaching example. Alex2.1 data are not redefined.
checks.reference: Approved: illustrative adult assay reference<5mg/L, sourced to CDC/Roche; visible laboratory-variation qualification.
checks.prevention: Approved: strict>2mg/L if persistent, consistent with European ESC/EAS2025 risk-modifier wording.
checks.future_association: Approved: relevant to future heart risk if persistent expresses relevance/association, not an individual forecast or CRP causation.
checks.visible_qualifications: Approved: Heart risk review, conditional threshold, repeat when well, laboratory variation and no-diagnosis note remain visible.
checks.progressive_disclosure: Acceptable: fuller overall-risk/history/other-inflammatory-cause explanation may remain in native details because the closed graphic only prompts risk review and does not diagnose, quantify personal risk or recommend treatment.
checks.visual_meaning: Approved at source level: overlap2–5 is shared reference/risk-review territory. Neutral below-threshold region is not labelled universally optimal or safe; chart description explicitly excludes disease probability.
checks.sources: Approved: CDC2021manual, ESC/EAS2025 guidance and ERFC prospective association source support the stated facts.

ongoing_limits: Do not relabel the lower region as a universal longevity-optimal range.
Do not say this sample will lead to disease, that hs-CRP itself is causal, or that3.2predicts one person’s future.
Do not introduce automatic treatment or a fixed universal repeat interval.
